$comment: The Meet contact filter refusing a message (design §8.2; ADR-0026 D2; OD-40, decided: block before delivery). A blocked message is never delivered, so there is no bubble and the other person sees nothing. The refusal writes a strike, which is why it is returned as a status and never raised: a raise would roll the strike back (D24). The test vectors behind these outcomes are in contact_filter_cases.json.

blocked.show: An inline safety banner, 'Phone numbers, emails, links and social handles can't be shared in Meet', with no bubble. Keep the draft in the composer so the sender can edit it.

third_strike.show: Three strikes in 24 hours restrict new messages for 24 hours. Disable the composer and show when it reopens. This is a rate limit, not a ban; five strikes in 7 days open a case for a person.

solicitation.show: A banner naming the category, for example 'Asking for money or gifts isn't allowed in Meet' (wording is M1-PR11's). The same strike counting applies.

platform_mention.show: Delivered, with a one-time tip to the sender about keeping the conversation in Meet (wording is M1-PR11's). No strike.

profile_surface.note: On first_name, bio, prompts, statuses and game answers the filter raises instead: nothing is written and nothing is recorded, so raising is safe. Solicitation raises ERR_MEET_SOLICITATION_NOT_ALLOWED.

reach_note_m2.note: A reach request whose note is blocked is not sent and costs nothing: the wallet is unchanged.

what_the_sender_never_sees: The matched text. Only the category comes back, because echoing the span would teach evasion.
message_ids: meet_messages.id is a bigint, as for errands chat: treat it as an opaque value, not an int that fits in a double.
